column1: # Ultra Kaiju Monster Rancher (KTGL engine on SDK 13.3.5, update 1.0.1). Started from the NSP script's profile (dm/games/profile_guess.py);
# checked by hand against the survey: the modules (subsdk0 is the SDK's movie library), the heap and the 0 MB system resource from the NPDM.
# main sets a heap of at most the pool − 64 MB: a 3328 MB heap region
# the NPDM declares 0 MB of system resource: IsVirtualAddressMemoryEnabled is false, as on Horizon (Big Brain Academy: Brain vs. Brain sets a heap only then)
# Handheld, the game draws its 3D views into a 960x540 viewport with a 2048x2048 shadow map; docked, 1920x1080 and 3072x3072 (it reads nn::oe::GetOperationMode, main+0x1c1aa4).
# UI and text are 1920x1080 in both. On the AYN Odin 2 (Adreno 740), the battle's "Start Battle" screen took GPU p50 11.7 ms handheld and 17.6 ms docked at 30 fps, with
# no frame late on screen in either; the player can switch to docked in the app's menu for the sharper 3D view
# The shaders are GLSLC outputs in main and in the RomFS's chunked zlib files with 128 KB chunks (shader/*Shader.lnkbin.gz, shader/ScreenLayoutShader.g1s.gz,
# stage/stage_terrain_shader.lnkbin.gz; shader_split.py kt_gz). Before the split read that form, the effects, the battle UI's text and the terrain drew only
# after the app had captured them on the device and a second port. 30 fps only: the game steps its logic a fixed 1/30 s per frame (30.0 at 30-odd conversion
# sites in main), so at 60 it runs twice as fast, and FPSLocker-Warehouse has no config for this build
